description: Publish a draft document revision so it can be sent for electronic signature. Generates a PDF and document hash. Confirm with the user before publishing. After publishing, use send-signing-request to distribute it.

allow_unfilled_fields.description: Only set true after telling the user which template fields are unfinished and getting explicit approval to publish with those labels still visible.

base_version.description: The lock_version of the exact draft state reviewed and approved for publication. Read and review again if it changed.

revision_id.description: The ULID of the draft revision to publish.

name: publish-document-revision-tool
title: Publish Document Revision
